warning: Neither method is ground truth. Assume independent errors, constant variance ratio and a linear relationship. Outliers, heteroscedasticity and wrong grouping can invalidate fits. Holds remain in audit, excluded from fits. No confidence intervals, automatic calibration, extrapolation or instrument changes.
